triggers.triggerDefinition: CREATE TRIGGER directed_invite_legacy_guard BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.journey_invites FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trip_directed_invite_legacy_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER core_v2_person_read_invalidation AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.journey_members FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trip_core_invalidate_actor_read()
CREATE TRIGGER journey_members_participation_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.journey_members FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_trip_person_participation()
CREATE TRIGGER journey_members_personal_payment_history_grant AFTER UPDATE OF user_id, status ON public.journey_members FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ledger_grant_linked_personal_payment_history_1a()
CREATE TRIGGER journey_members_touch_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.journey_members FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER trip_person_transition_evidence_guard AFTER UPDATE ON public.journey_members DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.participation_active IS DISTINCT FROM new.participation_active) OR (old.participation_revision IS DISTINCT FROM new.participation_revision))) EXECUTE FUNCTION trip_person_transition_evidence_guard()
